name: Minas Gerais floods
headline: Persistent localised rain; wettest February since 1961 in Juiz de Fora.

sections.The trigger: Persistent localised rain; wettest February since 1961 in Juiz de Fora.
sections.What amplified it: Unplanned homes on steep slopes; ~130,000 in high-risk zones; sirens did not reach all.
sections.Still open: Summary entry: the full deep-dive (day-by-day timeline, steering, how it ended, sources) has not been written yet. It will be added as the log works back through the year.
